verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that an official Pinecone SDK exists: backups can be managed "using the Pinecone SDK, API, or console", and the official llms.txt lists SDKs among its documented surfaces. That is only a glancing mention, with no detail on the SDKs themselves. The published OpenAPI specs and the mock-API guide are developer building blocks, not SDKs, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: which languages are covered, installation and usage documentation, SDK feature coverage across data/control/inference planes, SDK versioning or maintenance details, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
